paper_metadata.title: Plasticity Improvement in a Co-Rich Co40Fe25Cr20Ni15 High-Entropy Alloy via Al Alloying

evidence.quote: In this work, we developed Co-rich (Co40Fe25Cr20Ni15)100−xAlx (x = 0 and 5 at.%) HEAs and investigated their tensile behaviors at room temperature.
